name: SoFIE-GEL
notes: Flames spread over PMMA at oxygen concentrations as low as ~15% in quiescent microgravity — below typical Earth extinction limits (~17–18%).

name: BASS-II
fuel_or_material: PMMA spheres, cotton fabric, Nomex, polycarbonate

name: FLEX / FLEX-2
notes: Discovered sustained 'cool flame' chemistry: droplets kept burning invisibly at ~600 K long after the visible hot flame extinguished.

name: ACME
notes: Mapped soot inception and growth in laminar coflow diffusion flames without buoyancy-driven distortion.

name: Saffire I–VI
fuel_or_material: SIBAL cloth (cotton/fiberglass), Nomex, PMMA, structured material panels
notes: Largest deliberate fires ever set in an uncrewed spacecraft — flame behavior at ~meter scale differs from small CIR samples.

name: SAME
fuel_or_material: Teflon, Kapton, Pyrell foam, silicone rubber, cellulose
notes: Measured particle size distribution of smoke from overheated and ignited spacecraft materials.

name: Confined Combustion
notes: Flame spread between close parallel plates (confined geometry, like racks/ducts) is strongly affected by wall heat recirculation.

name: FLARE
notes: Directly maps material flammability limits at Lunar (0.17 g) and Martian (0.38 g) gravity using an on-orbit centrifuge.
